text.description_html:
PDQ 6400V Heavy Duty Narrow Stile Surface Vertical Rod Exit Device

Heavy duty surface vertical rod exit device for use on narrow stile doos in medium and high traffic commercial, hospitality, institutional applications. Suitable for all doors (aluminum, hollow metal, or wood), durable enough for the most demanding applications. Available in your choice of Satin Stainless Steel, Satin Chrome, Polished Brass, Flat Black, or Dark Bronze finish.

For 30" - 36" Wide Doors, furnished standard with wood and machine screws, optional sex bolts available. Listed for UL 305 Panic and UL 10C Fire Exit Hardware up to 3 hours. ANSI/BHMA Certified Grade 1, A156.3 2001 Exit Devices. Non-handed. reversible for left or right hand doors.

Meets requirements of the Buy American Act. ADA compliant and ICC/ANSI 117.1 for accessible and usable buildings. Compliant with FL #40297 +50/-50 psf 8080 18ga pair.

Specifications for PDQ 6400V Surface Vertical Rod Exit Device

  • Rail: Extruded aluminum
  • Top Latch Bolt: Stainless Steel 3/4" Toggle
  • Bottom Latch Bolt: 5/8" Travel Drop Bolt
  • Hand: Device is non-handed
  • Dogging: Hex key dogging standard, cylinder dogging available
  • Application: Surface Vertical Rod (7'0" tall door standard)
  • Minimum Stile Width: 3-1/8" with standard strike, 2-1/8 on aluminum frames with optional blade stop strike
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"-2"
  • Door Width: Standard 3'0" door maximum
  • Door Height: Standard Up to 7' High Door.
  • Certifications: Listed for UL 305 Panic and UL 10C Fire Exit Hardware up to 3 hours. ANSI/BHMA Certified Grade 1, A156.3 2001 Exit Devices. Meets requirements of the Buy American Act. ADA compliant and ICC/ANSI 117.1 for accessible and usable buildings. Compliant with FL #40297 +50/-50 psf 8080 18ga pair.
  • Warranty: Ten (10) year limited manufacturer warranty mechanical components
